# Roadmap 0.1.1 compatibility fixture

This sanitized fixture captures the released 0.1.1 storage contract. Canonical
Markdown and configuration live under `.roadmap/`; `projection.sql` is a
portable snapshot of the derived SQLite projection and is deliberately kept
separate from the canonical-file digests.

The fixture contains one project, one milestone, visible and closed issues, an
archived issue, a dependency, a comment, a legacy `github_issue` reference,
modern remote references, and user-authored Markdown. It contains no secrets,
real remotes, user paths, or credentials.
